title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Answers to common questions about products

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: Check your orders in your account. Contact the store if you need help.

items.question: What payment methods are available in the store?
items.answer: Available payment methods appear during checkout.

items.question: How are shipping costs and delivery time calculated?
items.answer: Review shipping method, cost and estimated delivery time when placing an order. Contact the store for details about your destination.

items.question: Is it possible to return or exchange a product?
items.answer: Return or exchange conditions depend on the product and order. Contact Gajet 30 support before sending an item back.

items.question: How can I use discounts and coupons?
items.answer: If you have an active discount code, enter it at checkout and check the final total before paying.

items.question: Do the products come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty type and duration, when available, are listed with each product. Contact the store for more details.

items.question: How can I manage my user account?
items.answer: Sign in to view and manage your account information and orders.

items.question: Is wholesale or special ordering available?
items.answer: For special or larger orders, call 09156304012.
